name: Jo Hayes
roles: National spokesperson for Māori development; Whānau Ora (2017–2020)
photo_credit: Office of the Clerk of the House of Representatives of New Zealand — https://www.parliament.nz/en/get-involved/features/new-zealand-women-mps-continuing-to-break-barriers/
status_detail: Lost her seat in 2020; became general manager of Rangitāne Tū Mai Rā Trust (iwi post-settlement entity). Stood for Masterton mayor 2022 (unsuccessful).
